AbbreviationName.description: A K, M or B scaling in a layout.

AggregateName.description: An aggregate's name in a layout.

oneOf.description: Value of the earliest inserted row.
Value of the latest inserted row.
From zero: a negative value's bar runs left, in the loss colour.

CalendarName.description: The market calendar a trading-time axis follows, in a layout.

oneOf.description: The New York Stock Exchange's, 09:30 to 16:00 by default.

SIFMA's recommendations for the US bond market, which close on Columbus
Day and Veterans Day as well and close early at 2 p.m. before some
holidays, 08:00 to 17:00 by default.

ChartKindName.description: What a chart draws, in a layout.

oneOf.description:
Bars of the layout's grouped view: one per group, one per measure or
column pivot within it.

Points: each row as a dot while the range shown holds at most 5,000,
and a density past that.

Cells of the layout's grouped view, coloured by its first measure: groups
across, column pivots up.
Counts of the x values in bins.
Candles of each bucket's open, high, low and close.
Bars of each bucket's open, high, low and close.

Slices of the layout's grouped view, one per group, sized by its first
measure, as a ring when `donut` is set.

Steps of the layout's grouped view, one per group: each floats from the
running total of its first measure before it to the one after, and a
total bar ends them, as attribution and P&L explain are drawn.

FilterOpName.description: A filter operator in a layout.

oneOf.description:
Text not containing `value`, ignoring case. Blanks match, as in a
spreadsheet.

HeatScale.description: The scale a heat fill takes its colour from.

oneOf.description: From the column's least value to its greatest.
About zero: losses one way, gains the other.

LayoutAnchor.description:
A point a drawing is anchored to: a value of the chart's x column, as in a
filter, and a value on the price's axis. Drawings stay with the data however
the chart is zoomed or its axis placed.

x.description: The x value: a date, an instant or a number.

y.description: The value on the price's axis.

oneOf.description: A bar as long as the value over the column's domain, behind its text.

from.description: From zero, the default, or from the column's least value.

oneOf.description: A fill by value, behind text in the ink that reads on it.

scale.description: Sequential, the default, or diverging about zero.

oneOf.description:
A pill with the value's text, in the tone listed for it; a value not
listed is neutral.

values.description: The tone of each value, by its text.

oneOf.description:
A small line of the numbers in the cell's text, separated by spaces or
commas, such as `101.2 101.5 100.9`.
Text that reports a click to the app.

LayoutChart.description:
A chart, in a layout. Bar charts, heatmaps, pies and waterfalls draw the
layout's grouped view; the other kinds are reduced by the engine to the
plot's pixels.

calendar.description: The market calendar a trading-time axis follows; NYSE's if absent.

compare.description:
Each series as its percentage change from its first value in the range
shown, on a line or area chart.

donut.description: Draws a pie chart as a ring, with the total in its centre.

drawing_tools.description:
Shows the drawing tools above a chart that takes drawings. Off, a
small overview chart carries no toolbar, and the drawings the layout
holds are shown but not edited.

drawings.description: Lines, levels, rectangles and notes drawn over the price.

events.description: A column whose non-null values mark rows as events, such as earnings.

fit.description:
A scatter's numeric column holding a fitted curve's value at each row's
x, such as the API's fitted spread at each bond's duration: drawn as a
line through each series.

hidden.description: Series hidden from the plot, by their legend labels.

horizontal.description: Bars running across instead of up.

id.description:
The column naming each dot of a scatter, such as a bond's CUSIP: the
title of its tooltip, and the value a click on it selects.

indicators.description:
Technical-analysis indicators, computed over every row before the chart
is reduced.

labels.description:
Writes each bar's value at its end, and each slice's share on it,
where they fit.

ohlc.description: The price columns of candlestick and OHLC charts.

panes.description: Panes under a line or area chart's plot, each with columns of its own.

range.description: The x range zoomed to; absent shows everything.

reverse_y.description:
Turns the left value axis upside down, for yields, where a rise is a
loss to a long position.

reverse_y_right.description: Turns the right value axis upside down.

rising.description:
Which colour a rise takes: candles, OHLC bars, volume, MACD's
histogram, a pane's bars and a waterfall's steps.

series.description: A column whose values split each plotted column into series.

session.description: A trading-time axis's session; the calendar's regular session if absent.

size.description:
A scatter's numeric column whose magnitude sets each dot's area, such as
DV01 or par.

stacked.description: Bars of one group stacked instead of side by side.

tenor_spacing.description: How a tenor axis spaces tenors.

tooltip.description: More columns a scatter's dot lists in its tooltip, in order.

volume.description: The volume column, which a VWAP and volume read.

x.description: The x column of reduced kinds; a histogram bins it.

y.description: Columns drawn against the left y axis.

y_right.description: Columns drawn against a second y axis on the right.

LayoutDrawing.description: A drawing on a chart, in a layout.

oneOf.description: A line across the chart at a value.

y.description: The value on the price's axis.

oneOf.description:
Fibonacci retracement levels between two points: 0 %, 23.6 %, 38.2 %,
50 %, 61.8 %, 78.6 % and 100 % of the way from one to the other.
A text note at a point.

LayoutExpanded.description: A group the user expanded or collapsed.

path.description: The group's values from the outermost level.

columns.description:
More columns the condition is tested in: the filter passes when it holds
in `column` or in any of these, as a search across columns does.

LayoutFormat.description:
How a column's values are displayed. Unset fields take the type's default:
a decimal's scale, no decimals for integers, one when abbreviating, and two
otherwise; thousands grouped; instants in `America/New_York` to the second.

abbreviate.description:
Divide by a thousand, million or billion and append `K`, `M` or `B`, or
as `suffixes` says.

bps.description: Write a rate, a fraction, in basis points with ` bp`: 0.0025 is `25 bp`.

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point, at most 30.

suffixes.description:
How an abbreviation is written: `amount`'s `K`, `M` and `B`, or `par`'s
`M`, `MM` and `BN`, as bond markets write par amounts.

thirty_seconds.description: Write a price in 32nds, `99-16+`, to its finest step.

zone.description: The IANA zone instants are shown in.

LayoutHaving.description: An aggregate filter in a layout.

LayoutIndicator.description:
A technical-analysis indicator, in a layout, with TA-Lib's usual defaults.
Averages, bands and VWAP are drawn over the price; the others in panes of
their own.

oneOf.description: The simple moving average of the price.
The exponential moving average of the price.
The weighted moving average of the price.
Bollinger Bands around the price's simple average.
The relative strength index of the price.

signal.description: Rows of the signal line's average.

k.description: Rows whose range the close is placed in.

format.description: The display format, overriding the one derived from the column's.

unit_column.description: A column naming each row's unit.

LayoutOhlc.description: The price columns of a candlestick or OHLC chart, in a layout.

LayoutOrder.description: How a text column's values are ordered, in a layout.

oneOf.description: Alphabetically, ignoring case, as text sorts without an order.

Tenors by length, `3M` before `1Y` and `10Y`: a whole number from 1 to
9999 and `D`, `W`, `M` or `Y`. Text that is not a tenor comes after.

Credit ratings, best first, on S&P's and Fitch's scale and Moody's, a
notch of one equal to the same notch of the other. Text that is not a
rating, such as `NR`, comes after.
As listed; values not listed come after.

By another column's smallest value among the rows with each value, such
as a tenor bucket by its rows' shortest maturity.

LayoutPane.description:
A pane under a line or area chart's plot, in a layout: columns of its own on
a value axis of its own, on the chart's x axis, sharing its crosshair and
zoom, as an indicator's pane does, such as the change in basis points under
curves.

columns.description:
The numeric columns it draws, split into series as the plot's are; a
series with no values in the range shown is left out.

reverse.description: Turns its value axis upside down.

title.description: Its title; its columns' names if empty.

LayoutRange.description: An x range a chart was zoomed to, in axis positions.

LayoutRule.description: A conditional format: the cells whose value meets `when` take `format`.

LayoutSession.description:
A trading day's session in New York time, in a layout: `HH:MM` times. A
session that opens later in the day than it closes opens the evening before
its trading day.

opens.description: When it opens, such as `08:00`, or `18:00` the evening before.

other.description: Show the rest as one Other row.

NegativeName.description: How negative numbers are written, in a layout.

PaneKindName.description: How a pane under a chart draws its columns, in a layout.

oneOf.description:
A bar from zero at each point: in the up and down colours for one
series, side by side in the series' colours for several.

RisingName.description: Which colour a rise takes on a chart, in a layout.

oneOf.description: The gain colour, as a rising price is a gain to a long position.
The loss colour, as a rising yield is a loss to a long position.

RuleFormat.description: How a rule styles a cell.

bold.description: Its text in the group font.

fill.description: A fill in the tone's tint behind the cell.

tone.description: The ink of its text, a tone's, or the column's for none.

RuleWhen.description: When a rule styles a cell: a filter's condition on the cell's value.

oneOf.description: Fraction of the parent row's value.

Excel's "Running Total In": the exact sum of the group's value and its
siblings' before it, in their order. Sums and counts only.

SuffixesName.description: How an abbreviation is written, in a layout.

oneOf.description:
`M` for thousands, `MM` for millions and `BN` for billions, as bond
markets write par amounts and `AmountInput` reads them back.

TenorSpacingName.description: How a tenor axis spaces tenors, in a layout.

oneOf.description:
The standard tenors 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 3Y, 5Y, 7Y, 10Y, 20Y, 30Y, 50Y
and 100Y one step apart, and a tenor between two placed between them by
length, as desks' curve screens space them.

ThirtySecondsName.description: The finest step of a price in 32nds, in a layout.

Tone.description:
A status's colour and shape, from the theme: a gain, a loss, a warning, a
note, or nothing to note.

oneOf.description: A gain, or what is good.
A loss, or what is wrong.

XAxisName.description: How a chart places x values, in a layout.

oneOf.description:
By trading time on the chart's `calendar`, NYSE's unless it says
otherwise, in its `session`.

By tenor, labelled `3M` to `30Y`: the x column holds tenors as text,
such as `3M` and `10Y`, or as years.

description: A view, as saved and sent.

cells.description:
How a flat or detail view's cells draw, by source column: as a data bar,
a heat fill, a badge, a sparkline or a link, rather than as text. The
engine computes the domain of a flat view's bar and heat columns, which
each frame carries.

chart.description: Draws the view as a chart instead of a grid.

column_widths.description:
Column widths in CSS pixels, chosen by the user. Keys are source column
names for flat views, `"__measure:0"`, `"__measure:1"` and so on for the
data columns of grouped views, and `"__tree"` for the group column. The
engine ignores them.

columns.description: Columns of a flat view, in order. Empty means every column.

dataset.description:
The dataset the view reads. Empty in layouts sent with an open-view
request, which names the dataset itself; when both are given they must
agree.

detail.description:
Groups `group_by` with the rows under them, in `sort` order and with the
`columns`, as a grid does, rather than as a pivot of measures.

expanded.description: Groups expanded or collapsed by the user, by value.

formats.description:
Display formats by source column. Measures take their column's format
unless they set their own.

group_sort.description: Ordering of groups among their siblings.

orders.description:
Orders of text columns other than alphabetical, by column: tenors by
length, ratings best first, a listed order, or another column's values.
Groups at every level, column pivots, sorts, a chart's series and the
categories of bars, heatmaps and pies follow them; filters still compare
text.

parameters.description: The dataset's parameters, such as an as-of date.

pinned.description:
Columns of a flat or detail view kept at the left while the rest scroll,
in order. They come first, whatever `columns` says.

rules.description:
Conditional formats of a flat or detail view's cells, by source column:
the first rule whose condition a cell's value meets styles it.

search.description:
Text to search for, ignoring case, in every searched column: the text
columns a flat view shows, those and the group columns of a detail view,
or the group and column-pivot columns of a pivot. Rows must match it as
well as the filters. Empty searches nothing.

titles.description:
Header text by source column, or by a measure's header, such as
`sum(par)` or `wmean(ytm by market_value)`; a column or measure without
one shows its name. The export's headers and a chart's legend are the
same.

totals.description:
The totals row of a flat or detail view: at most one total per column,
each a measure of its column. A detail view's group rows show them too.

version.description: The layout version; [`LAYOUT_VERSION`] for documents this crate writes.
